AT WORDS 12-13: typica 'Sanguine placari' vs the 1862 Pustet 'Snguine placri'; AT WORDS 16-16: typica 'quabsumus,' vs the 1862 Pustet 'qmesumus,'; AT WORDS 18-20: typica 'nostrae pretium (solemni' vs the 1862 Pustet 'nostra pr6tium sol6mni'; the 1862 Pustet spells 'cultu' where the typica spells 'cultu)' (orthography/accent only); AT WORDS 23-23: typica 'venerari,' vs the 1862 Pustet 'venerri,'; AT WORDS 26-26: typica 'praesentis' vs the 1862 Pustet 'prasentis'; the 1862 Pustet spells 'vitoe' where the typica spells 'vitae' (orthography/accent only); the 1862 Pustet prints 'malis,' where the typica prints 'malis' (pointing only); the 1862 Pustet spells 'ejus' where the typica spells 'eius' (orthography/accent only); the 1862 Pustet prints 'virtute,' where the typica prints 'virtute' (pointing only); AT WORDS 39-39: typica 'caelis.' vs the 1862 Pustet 'cnelis.'; AT WORDS 41-42: typica 'eundem Dominum.' vs the 1862 Pustet 'efimdem D6minum.'; AT WORDS 0-0: typica 'OMNIPOTENS' vs the 1922 Mame 'MNIPOTENS'; the 1922 Mame has 'O' where the typica has nothing at this point; AT WORDS 5-5: typica 'Filium' vs the 1922 Mame "'illum"; the 1922 Mame spells 'ejus' where the typica spells 'eius' (orthography/accent only); the 1922 Mame prints 'voluisti' where the typica prints 'voluisti:' (pointing only); AT WORDS 16-16: typica 'quabsumus,' vs the 1922 Mame 'queesumus,'; the 1922 Mame spells 'nostre' where the typica spells 'nostrae' (orthography/accent only); the 1922 Mame spells 'presentis' where the typica spells 'praesentis' (orthography/accent only); the 1922 Mame spells 'vite' where the typica spells 'vitae' (orthography/accent only); the 1922 Mame spells 'ejus' where the typica spells 'eius' (orthography/accent only); the 1922 Mame spells 'letemur' where the typica spells 'laetemur' (orthography/accent only); the 1922 Mame spells 'celis.' where the typica spells 'caelis.' (orthography/accent only); AT WORDS 41-41: typica 'eundem' vs the 1922 Mame 'etimdem'. Corroboration: Two independent public-domain witnesses were read for every oration: the Pustet Ratisbon 1862 whole-book text layer and the Tours: Mame 1922 editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam (artifact ia-scan-pdf-9873693a), the latter reconstructed column by column from its page word bounding boxes. The Vatican typica 1604 and Venice 1570 were swept but not relied on (both are registered degraded-latin and their records forbid resting a claim on a raw search over them).. Recorded limitation: || REPAIRED by lane repair-2 on 2026-09-03. The stored target had been a text-layer reading carrying recogniser damage; it has been replaced word for word by a reading taken from the 1962 CMAA facsimile page image at 400 dpi (artifact PDF p. 654, printed folio read on the same image). Line-end hyphens are joined, printed stress accents are dropped, and the ae/oe ligatures are expanded to two letters; punctuation, capitalisation and the conclusion are reproduced at the length the page prints them. The verdict, the antecedent locus and the recorded differences are the original lane's and were not revisited. The marginal number 2938 already in the locus was confirmed on the same 400 dpi image. Artifact PDF p. 654 is the opening leaf of the Festa Iulii section and carries neither a running head nor a printed folio, so the folio could not be read on this page itself; the offset of 81 is confirmed on the facing leaf, artifact PDF p. 655, whose folio prints 574, and by the two orations of this same mass which stand there. The two words the rubric below the oration allows to be omitted in votive Masses are printed within parentheses and are reproduced with their parentheses.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui unigenitum Filium tuum mundi Redemptorem
constituisti, ac ejus Sanguine placari voluisti: concede, quaesumus, salutis
nostrae pretium (solemni cultu) ita venerari, atque a praesentis vitae malis
ejus virtute defendi in terris; ut fructu perpetuo laetemur in caelis. Per
eundem Dominum.

propers.text:
Per haec divina mysteria, ad novi, quaesumus, testamenti mediatorem Jesum
accedamus: et super altaria tua, Domine virtutum, aspersionem Sanguinis
melius loquentem, quam Abel, innovemus. Per eundem Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Ad sacram, Domine, mensam admissi, hausimus aquas in gaudio de fontibus
Salvatoris: Sanguis ejus fiat nobis, quaesumus, fons aquae in vitam aeternam
salientis: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.
